name: Aft fixed test support
definition: UX, UY, UZ, ROTX, ROTY, ROTZ = 0
note: Ground-test and screening only; not a flight boundary condition

name: Minimum stabilisation
note: Use only to remove rigid-body motion in static flight screening

name: Free-free
note: Modal: verify six near-zero rigid-body modes

name: Inertia relief
definition: ANSYS inertia relief with applied thrust/inertial loads
note: Preferred later flight static representation where supported

name: Remote mass coupling
scope: Subsystem CG remote points to reviewed attachment nodes
note: Do not leave MASS21 points uncoupled

name: Ring bearing sensitivity
scope: Ring inner nodes to spine interface
note: Required because bearing and drive stiffness is not yet designed
